summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements. REQ-2 (MP4 upload), REQ-3 (admin gating), and REQ-4 (native video player) are largely implemented. REQ-1 has gaps: the spec requires an isAdmin(principal) query accepting a principal argument, but only isCallerAdmin() is exposed. The deployer pre-registration is handled via a token-based initialize() call rather than automatic deployment-time registration. Additional unrequested features were added including user profile management, a complex role system, and URL parameter/session storage utilities for admin token management.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose a query isAdmin(principal) that returns true if the given principal is in the admin list.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend exposes isCallerAdmin() which checks the caller's own principal, rather than isAdmin(principal) which accepts an arbitrary principal argument as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Pre-register the deployer's principal as the initial admin.
missing_requirements.reason: The admin is registered via an explicit initialize() call with a secret token rather than being automatically pre-registered at deploy time for the deployer's principal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Non-admin users do not see the file upload option.
missing_requirements.reason: VideoUploadForm.tsx renders both URL and MP4 upload options without an admin check inside the form itself. While the form is only rendered inside the admin-gated AdminDashboard, the form component itself does not conditionally hide the MP4 option based on admin status.

hallucinated_features.description: URL parameter utilities including session storage persistence, hash-based routing parameter extraction, and admin token management via a caffeineAdminToken URL parameter.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention URL parameter utilities, session storage for admin tokens, or any token-based URL parameter system. This is entirely new functionality not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Role-based access control with an assignRole endpoint and a multi-role UserRole system beyond simple admin/non-admin.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly lists user roles beyond a simple admin/non-admin distinction as a non-goal. The backend includes assignRole and AccessControl.UserRole suggesting a more complex role system.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management with getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, and getUserProfile backend endpoints and associated state.
hallucinated_features.reason: User profile management was not requested in the build request and is not part of any stated requirement.
